commands: if [ -d .wingfoil ]; then wingfoil memory add --type decision-log --title 'Orders are cancelled, not deleted' > /dev/null && ID=$(ls docs/memory/decision-log | grep cancelled | sed 's/[.]md$//') && wingfoil memory submit "$ID" > /dev/null && wingfoil memory approve "$ID" --reason 'Approved. Proceed.' > /dev/null; fi
if [ -d .wingfoil ]; then wingfoil directives list --role developer > rules.json && wingfoil memory search --type decision-log --status approved > decisions.json; fi
